english_draft:
Meta reported Q1 2026 revenue of USD 56.311 billion. Revenue rose 33% year over year. Operating income was USD 22.872 billion. Operating margin was 41%. Diluted EPS was USD 10.44. This EPS included an income tax benefit of USD 8.03 billion. Excluding the benefit would reduce diluted EPS by USD 3.13. Family DAP averaged 3.56 billion in March 2026. Family DAP rose 4% year over year. Ad impressions rose 19% year over year.

For Q2 2026, the main question is whether revenue growth can remain near 30%. The second question is whether operating margin can remain near 40%. The third question is how EPS will look after the one-time tax benefit.

A positive surprise would be revenue growth above 30%. A positive surprise would also be stable operating margin. A negative surprise would be a sharp slowdown in revenue growth. A negative surprise would be a lower operating margin. EPS may face slower growth if the tax benefit does not repeat.

Verification points for Q2: revenue growth, operating margin, diluted EPS, effective tax rate, ad impressions, and Family DAP.
